precedence: This override is higher authority for Year 6 SAT lesson access/release semantics, SAT CSV/display-code resolution, canonical batch-definition classification of Maths equivalent-view entitlements, and navigation presentation for Year 4/L1, Year 5/L2 and Year 6/L3. All non-conflicting Portal V2 authority remains binding.

ownerRequirement.rule: Year 6 SAT lessons must not inherit broad MATHS_Y6_FULL / Year 6 full-view core access. They are released lesson-by-lesson through the normal Lesson Release Import workflow.
ownerRequirement.ordinaryYear6Boundary: Normal Year 6 lessons retain existing full-library and direct-release semantics.
ownerRequirement.displayPreservation: Admin tables, CSV-facing state and parent-facing lesson labels retain Y6SMn. Internal resolver compatibility may translate Y6SMn to legacy Y6MSn and then canonical Y6M(50+n), but must not expose the legacy alias to users.

navigationPresentation.globalEquivalentRule: A Maths student must never be shown both members of an equivalent curriculum pair: Year 4/L1, Year 5/L2, or Year 6/L3. If the L-level exists, the L-level is the teaching-curriculum presentation.
navigationPresentation.l3Student: Show L3 as the teaching curriculum. Do not show a duplicate Year 6 card. Show a separate SATS card only when that L3 student has at least one genuine released or PreLesson-available SATS lesson. An L3 student with no SATS access must not receive a SATS card merely because L3 and Year 6 share canonical content.
navigationPresentation.ordinaryYear6Student: Show Lessons and SATS. Lessons contains the normal Year 6 teaching curriculum; SATS contains the SAT lesson subset.
navigationPresentation.year4Level1: If current Year 4 and L1 are both present for the same Maths curriculum, present L1 only.
navigationPresentation.year5Level2: If current Year 5 and L2 are both present for the same Maths curriculum, present L2 only.
navigationPresentation.accessBoundary: Equivalent-card collapsing and the Lessons/SATS split are presentation/navigation transformations only. They must not broaden lesson entitlements, change batch membership, or convert SAT direct-release access into full Year 6 access.

entitlementClassification.prohibitedPrimaryHeuristic: Do not classify normal-vs-11plus from whether a batch-code string contains '11'.
entitlementClassification.equivalenceRule: For Maths only, Year 4/L1, Year 5/L2 and Year 6/L3 are equivalent curriculum presentations. A canonical entitlement from either member may be honoured through the student's selected equivalent teaching card while the home screen still exposes only one member of the pair.

implementation.mapping: Y6SM1..Y6SM19 -> internal compatibility Y6MS1..Y6MS19 -> canonical Y6M51..Y6M69
implementation.finalCompositionRule: index-admin-tools.js delegates ordinary requests to index-maths-equivalent-navigation-final.js; that wrapper delegates to the complete current index-phase24-trial-vr.js chain, refreshes L3 counts from the batch-definition-aware live list, normalises the final home response, then suppresses SATS for L3 when the live SATS subset has no released/PreLesson-available row.

syntheticPresentationViews.maths-year6-lessons: delegates authorization to canonical maths-year6 and filters out Y6 SAT lessons
syntheticPresentationViews.maths-sats: delegates authorization to canonical maths-year6 and filters to Y6 SAT lessons

implementation.frontendPrimaryNormalizerRule: Normalize the /api/v1/student/home JSON response before phase10-history records groups and before phase7 renders cards. Current Year 4/L1 and Year 5/L2 pairs collapse to L1/L2. A current L3 + Year 6 alias collapses to L3, with SATS added only when the synthetic SATS list has real access. This is authoritative browser-side protection against stale or lower-layer duplicate aliases.
implementation.frontendLegacyDomGuardRole: Compatibility fallback only; it is not the primary equivalent-card authority because phase10-history reparents rendered cards into grouped nested grids.
implementation.productionPreservationVerification: PASS: live entitlement-classification, equivalent-navigation, conditional-L3-SATS, Y6 SAT mapping/direct-release, shared Worker composition, forward-only deploy, live Worker markers, bindings, quiz bridge, Replace Resource, lesson-release import, Trial runtime and live parent-email routing all passed.

productionAudit20260927.conclusion: The duplicate Year 6/L3 display was not dual enrolment and was not caused by current SAT access. Shared canonical Y6 lesson IDs can legitimately back L3, but the visible teaching card must remain L3.

ownerEvidence: Devansh repeatedly showed Year 6 and L3 together after earlier server and DOM-level fixes reported successful deployment.
Kiaan showed current Year 4 + L1 and Year 5 + L2 together, plus L3 and 11+ Practice. Owner explicitly required Kiaan to show only L1, L2, L3 and 11+ Practice.
incident20260927.rootCause: The underlying entitlement data legitimately contains shared canonical lesson IDs and prepared aliases. Server-side normalisation was not sufficient as the sole browser guard, and the earlier post-render DOM fallback depended on cards being direct children of #view-grid. phase10-history reparents cards into grouped nested grids, so the fallback was not a reliable primary boundary.
incident20260927.forwardOnlyRepair: Keep canonical batch-definition entitlement classification and final Worker normalisation, add the v3 L3 SATS conditional guard, and normalize home JSON in the live frontend before history grouping/rendering. No rollback, revert or older Worker/frontend deployment was used.
incident20260927.remainingGate: Owner browser retest of Kiaan and Devansh. Kiaan must show L1, L2, L3 and 11+ Practice only. Devansh must never show Year 6 + L3; SATS appears separately only if he has genuine SATS access.

verificationMatrix: Y6SM1 resolves to canonical Y6M51 and Y6SM19 resolves to canonical Y6M69.
MATHS_Y6_FULL alone does not open Y6M51..Y6M69; SAT lessons remain lesson-by-lesson releases.
Current Year 4 plus L1 collapses to L1 and current Year 5 plus L2 collapses to L2.
Current Year 6 plus L3 never appears as two teaching cards; L3 is retained.
An L3 student with no released/PreLesson-available SATS has no SATS card.
An L3 student with genuine SATS access receives L3 + SATS.
An ordinary Year 6 student is presented with Lessons + SATS.
Canonical Y6 lesson entitlements from an L3 batch definition are recognised as L3/equivalent curriculum access even when the batch-code text does not contain '11'.
English normal-vs-11plus classification remains distinct and is not widened by the Maths equivalence rule.
The live frontend normalises home JSON before phase10-history grouping and phase7 card rendering.
Shared production Worker retains quiz bridge, Admin tools, Trial runtime, resource replacement, lesson release import, protected-answer behaviour and parent email capabilities.
preservationInvariants: Production recovery is forward-only; do not revert, roll back, restore an older Worker or deploy an older entrypoint.
Do not alter normal Year 6 lesson access or renumber canonical Y6 SAT lesson IDs.
Do not expose Y6MSn as the owner-facing code; Y6SMn is authoritative for CSV/display use.
Do not use Year 4, Year 5 or Year 6 duplicate cards when their L1, L2 or L3 equivalent is already present as current Maths teaching curriculum.
Do not give L3 students a SATS card unless at least one SATS lesson is genuinely released or PreLesson-available.
Do not classify an entitlement's programme stream primarily from batch-code naming when a canonical batch definition exists.
Do not alter Trial session semantics, normal student sessions, protected Answer Packs, online 11+ English PreLesson VR, resource replacement, parent-email routing or quiz bridge behaviour.
A green deployment and runtime markers are not substitutes for owner browser verification; do not declare this repair CLOSED PASS until representative live browser evidence confirms it.
